scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c auto "npm run dev -w @can-rat/server" "npm run dev -w @can-rat/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @can-rat/shared && npm run build -w @can-rat/server && npm run build -w @can-rat/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @can-rat/shared && npm run typecheck -w @can-rat/server && npm run typecheck -w @can-rat/client
